blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Eleven former members of extremist groups have surrendered to the military and were presented to the commander of the Army’s 601st Infantry Brigade during a ceremony at the headquarters of the 38th Infantry Battalion (38IB) in Datu Piang, Maguindanao del Sur, on Tuesday, Oct. 27. Lt. Col. Mark Anthony P. Tornalejo, 38IB commanding officer, presented the former violent extremists to Brig. Gen. Gremel B. Brual, commander of the 601st Infantry Brigade under the Army’s 6th Infantry Division. It was held at the 38IB battalion headquarters in Sitio Landing Fish, Barangay Buayan, Datu Piang, Maguindanao del Sur. READ: 6 […]...
